note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: # owner signs in once, off camera: az login
az group create -n rg-mglab-powerapps-14 -l swedencentral | Out-Null
$dep = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-powerapps-14 -f src/infra/main.bicep -p principalId=$(az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv) --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
$env:AZURE_TOKEN = az account get-access-token --resource https://cognitiveservices.azure.com --query accessToken -o tsv
# owner types the key off camera (prompt is masked); needs MG_CLAUDE_MODEL and the MG_PRICE_* variables read from each provider's price page that day

$k = Read-Host -MaskInput 'Anthropic API key (owner)'; az keyvault secret set --vault-name $env:MG_KV_NAME --name anthropic-api-key --value $k | Out-Null; $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = $k; Remove-Variable k

Read-Host 'Owner: import $env:TEMP\cin-ai.zip in DEV (browser); Foundry connector (OAuth, app registration contoso-lab-foundry-connector, secret typed in the portal), Anthropic connector, secret variable cin_AnthropicApiKey, flow ClaudeTriage, canvas TriageScreen and the model-driven custom page are built per demo.md; AI Builder answers typed by hand into $env:TEMP\aibuilder.jsonl; both demo users started the premium trial. Press Enter'

screens.name: azure-foundry
steps: Resource groups > rg-mglab-powerapps-14: the resource list
Open the Azure OpenAI account > Model deployments: triage, Standard, capacity 10

screens.name: claude-secret-flow
steps: Solutions > Contoso Inspections AI: environment variable cin_AnthropicApiKey (Secret, Azure Key Vault, no value visible)
Open the flow ClaudeTriage > Run history > one succeeded run: the key action outputs and the Triage inputs show as hidden
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
the API key must not be visible anywhere: if it is, stop, rotate it and re-record

screens.name: eval-run
commands: python src/eval/evaluate.py run --route foundry --endpoint $env:MG_AOAI_ENDPOINT --model triage --token-env AZURE_TOKEN --price-in $env:MG_PRICE_IN_FOUNDRY --price-out $env:MG_PRICE_OUT_FOUNDRY --save $env:TEMP/foundry.jsonl

screens.name: canvas-triage
steps: Play the field app as alex.demo (InPrivate): open an inspection > item 'Fire door wedged open' > AI suggestion
Azure OpenAI > Suggest: banner and summary > Save suggestion; then the Claude route
Open the model-driven app as sam.demo: the same item with the five AI columns filled and Severity untouched; open the page via AI suggestion once
Do not run the AI Builder route (no credits)
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge --name $env:MG_AOAI_NAME --resource-group rg-mglab-powerapps-14 --location swedencentral
Remove-Item Env:AZURE_TOKEN, Env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, Env:MG_AOAI_ENDPOINT, Env:MG_KV_NAME, Env:MG_AOAI_NAME -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host 'Reminder: revoke the Anthropic API key in its console; delete the client secret and app registration contoso-lab-foundry-connector; delete the solution Contoso Inspections AI, the prompt and the connections in DEV (warn first: the five AI columns go with it); delete the recorded test rows.'
needs: paid:Anthropic prepaid balance and Azure OpenAI tokens (cents)
blocked: claude-secret-flow, the Claude part of eval-run and the Claude route of canvas-triage need the owner's Anthropic API account with a prepaid balance and a key, which the lab does not have yet; the AI Builder route cannot run in an app (no credits). azure-foundry and the Azure OpenAI route can be recorded.
